name: Sgraffito
description: Horizontal scratches through a slip laid on in five levels.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 6%, transparent 6% 14%), linear-gradient(90deg, #000000ff 0.0% 20.0%, #000000cc 20.0% 40.0%, #00000099 40.0% 60.0%, #00000066 60.0% 80.0%, #00000033 80.0% 100.0%, transparent 100%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 6%, transparent 6% 14%), linear-gradient(90deg, #000000ff 0.0% 20.0%, #000000cc 20.0% 40.0%, #00000099 40.0% 60.0%, #00000066 60.0% 80.0%, #00000033 80.0% 100.0%, transparent 100%); -webkit-mask-composite: source-in; mask-composite: intersect; -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
